mechanism: A generic {{gate}} traffic-light enforcement primitive. Wraps a {{judge}} or {{condition}} that returns a trinary status (Red/Yellow/Green) and yields a {{decision}}: Red -> CLOSE (halt execution). Yellow -> DEBT (proceed with the obligation recorded to {{ledger}}). Green -> OPEN (proceed).
invariants: Yellow appends a remediation item and records the obligation to {{ledger}}. An unrecorded Yellow is a Green.
failure_modes: Yellow read as Green: both states proceed, so the obligation exists only in the {{ledger}}.
Debt accumulating unread: the obligation is recorded and nothing consumes it.
